files.description: EHI Export Designated Record Set data dictionary — XLSX with 2 sheets: 'EHI Export' (overview of export process) and 'DRS' (38 data classes, 893 fields with names, SQL data types, and descriptions). This is the primary EHI export documentation artifact.

CureMD general marketing brochure (20 pages). Covers EHR, billing, scheduling, specialties, and deployment options. NOT EHI export–specific — included for completeness as it was linked from the page navigation.
Saved HTML of the EHI export page. Contains the 170.315(b)(10) description, export format explanation, and link to the DRS XLSX.
Viewport screenshot of the EHI export page showing the hero banner, b(10) section, and XLSX download link.
Bun TypeScript script that extracts the XLSX data dictionary into queryable JSON. Parses both sheets, handles carried-forward class names, and outputs three JSON files.
Full extracted data dictionary: 38 data classes with 893 fields, each including field name, SQL data type, and description. Also includes the overview text from the 'EHI Export' sheet.
Summary of the data dictionary: data class names, field counts, field name lists, and unique data types per class.
Extraction metadata: row counts, parse failures (none), processing notes.
Instructions for running the enrichment script, input/output documentation, and known limitations.
